# Nervøsitet eller decideret panik - investorerne leder efter retningsgivere

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Millionærklubben episode (EuroInvestor, 2 Nov 2026) recorded after a sharp sell-off in AI and tech stocks. Guest Otto Friedrichsen of Formuepleje sees it as a correction driven by too-high earnings expectations and a rotation out of tech, not the start of a bear market. He says Formuepleje raised its equity exposure into the fall and expects the S&P 500 to finish 2026 higher. The panel (Lars Persson, Michelle Nørgaard) prefers defensive pharma, medtech, consumer staples and Swedish property, discusses Lars's sales of Nelly and Stora Enso, and flags e-commerce names ahead of Black Friday.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 BAVA — Bavarian Nordic | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars keeps his position: up 28% YTD, new UK vaccine order, now a steadier travel-vaccine business.

#### Reasoning

Lars (host-panel analyst) says stable travel-vaccine sales now underpin the business and order wins are upside on top. The stock broke above 240 in Sep-Oct. Michelle (guest) avoids it because order timing is hard to predict, so views are split.

#### Sell Triggers

- if government vaccine orders dry up
- if travel-vaccine sales weaken

> *"hjemme i min egen portefølje, der beholdte jeg min Bavarian Nordic"*

---

### 🟢 GMAB — Genmab | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michelle bought Genmab instead of Bavarian Nordic, expecting it to run faster.

#### Reasoning

Michelle prefers Genmab's more predictable commercial business over order-driven vaccine names. Genmab also gained more than 80% during the stock game.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the stock starts to drift lower (Michelle's cut-losers rule)

> *"der er nogle andre galopheste, der forhåbentlig løber hurtigere, såsom Genmark blandt andet, jeg har valgt at gå ind i i stedet for"*

---

### 🟠 NELLY — Nelly | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars sold at about a 40% loss. Would rebuy around 38-39 on renewed momentum; now about 35.

#### Reasoning

After big drops in February and May, the stock jumped to 38 on the Q3 report, then drifted to 36-37 without momentum. Lars wants a fresh technical buy signal before re-entering ahead of Black Friday. He dreams of 50.

#### Sell Triggers

- if there is no momentum or buy signal
- if more bad news like the February/May reports

> *"Så kommer jeg måske til at købe til 38 eller 39, men hvis man kan få 50 for den, er det jo en meget god forretning"*

---

### 🔴 STE-R — Stora Enso | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars sold after a so-so report and a 3% drop; the position had no positive return.

#### Reasoning

Lars was cleaning up losing positions; he sold on a lukewarm report and the lack of any gain.

> *"Den havde ikke givet noget positiv afkast. Så jeg har ryttet lidt op"*

---

### 🟠 BOOZT — Boozt | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lars may buy before the upcoming report on Black Friday and e-commerce strength.

#### Reasoning

Lars points to the Black Friday season and Lyko's strong report as signs that e-commerce is healthy. He admits Boozt fooled him last time, so this is speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report disappoints
- if Black Friday demand is weak

> *"lige om lidt kommer Boost også med et regnskab"*

---

### 🟢 CLA-B — Cloetta | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

US candy launch at higher prices; despite the rise from 24 to 150, Lars still sees interesting potential.

#### Reasoning

Lars (host-panel analyst) sees the US expansion with better pricing as a fresh growth driver for a defensive consumer name.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the US launch fails to gain traction

> *"jeg ser stadigvæk et interessant potentiale i den aktie"*

---

### 🟠 AZN — AstraZeneca | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fantastic company; strong latest report but only up 5% YTD. A defensive shelter.

#### Reasoning

Lars suggests large-cap pharma as a defensive rotation target during the tech correction; AstraZeneca has lagged in recent years.

#### Sell Triggers

- if pharma sentiment turns down

> *"det seneste regnskab har jo også gjort, at den igen ser måske interessant ud"*

---

### 🟠 SOBI — Sobi | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Defensive pharma with its own products plus contract manufacturing.

#### Reasoning

Lars lists it among defensive pharma names to hide in while tech is volatile.

> *"Så er der vores gode gamle Sobi"*

---

### 🟡 AMBU-B — Ambu | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars holds it; medtech has been tired but may be brightening.

#### Reasoning

Lars sees medtech as a defensive sector where things may be turning, and admits he is biased because he owns it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the medtech recovery fails

> *"jeg har begge to derhjemme"*

---

### 🟠 AXFO — Axfood | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Defensive food retailer, but political pressure on living costs could affect it.

#### Reasoning

Lars mentions it as a defensive staple; he does not worry about its earnings but expects some change in the sector.

#### Sell Triggers

- if political price pressure squeezes margins

> *"man kan jo måske stadigvæk gå hen og købe noget inden for Axfood"*

---

### 🟠 VRTX — Vertex Pharmaceuticals | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Michelle is watching the pipeline and FDA timeline in today's report.

#### Reasoning

Michelle highlighted it earlier; whether she stays positive depends on pipeline news and FDA feedback.

#### Sell Triggers

- if FDA feedback is negative
- if the pipeline disappoints

> *"Hvornår kommer ud med FDA?"*

---
